title: Friedgut junta size bound
statement: For a Boolean function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional sign cube and a real number $\varepsilon$, define the Friedgut junta size bound to be $1+\frac{I(f)^3}{\varepsilon^2}9^{d}$, where $I(f)$ is the total influence of $f$ and $d$ is its Friedgut degree at $\varepsilon$.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
